scope: Bounded CA pack research. Confidence applies to the stated conclusion, not every related formula. No current campaign session or independent UI readings for new samples.

totalHealth.limitation: Three different hypotheses fit three manual references; new samples have no independent displayed HP. Scale/aggregation rules unverified.

displaySpeed.confidence: medium; three units, four manual movement comparisons
displaySpeed.limitation: No executable UI conversion or independent infantry UI readings; movement source selection and runtime effects remain unverified.

displayAmmo.limitation: 66/3, 22/1, 198/9 all yield 22; only Helstorm has a supplied display reference. projectile_number and burst_size are separate fields.

reloadTime.confidence: low for runtime formula; high for field separation
reloadTime.formulaHypothesis: baseReloadTime * (1 - landReload / 100) is a schema-motivated candidate, not a complete runtime formula
reloadTime.limitation: marksmanship_bonus is documented as accuracy, not reload. Base landReload=0 does not explain manual 15.3.

accuracy.confidence: medium for combined calibration influence; low for UI sum
accuracy.limitation: Schema confirms both fields influence calibration area, not their UI sum or exact scatter algorithm. spread semantics remain unresolved.

artillery.confidence: low for aggregates; high for separate entities
artillery.limitation: Crew/engine references and collision properties are confirmed. Crew allocation, aggregate HP/mass and displayed size are not. Generic_3_Crew is a key, not verified total crew count.

recruitmentTier.confidence: low for universal displayed tier; high for distinct raw fields
recruitmentTier.formulaHypothesis: level + 1 fits chain positions in selected ordinary chains, not a universal settlement tier
recruitmentTier.limitation: Forges level=2 requires settlement=4; Bloodthirster chain level=1 requires=5. enabled=false and effective campaign unlock conditions remain unresolved.

resistances.confidence: medium for raw-to-stat mapping; high for current UI labels
resistances.confirmedSubfinding: Current stat_resistance_magic localisation is Spell Resistance; stat_resistance_all uses a ward-save icon with Damage Resistance label.
resistances.limitation: damage_mod_magic to runtime stat mapping lacks a declarative join; current combat stacking, caps and magical attack interaction not established.

costDiscrepancies.confidence: low for causes of supplied manual differences
costDiscrepancies.limitation: Separate multiplayer/recruitment raw costs, XP costs, building and difficulty layers exist; manual version, rank and campaign context are absent. No cause assigned to 1850/1700 or 2000/4600/575.

runtimeOverrides.confidence: high for existence and schema paths only
runtimeOverrides.limitation: Technology, building, lord skill, difficulty, unit sets, recruitment locks, experience and ability phase paths are present. Application order and final effective stats/costs are not calculated.
